name: Terraria – TShock 5
description: For TShock 5.x, which logs chat as "Name: message" instead of "<Name> message". Other console lines that look like "Word: text" (for example some plugin or error output) can also be posted as chat; add them to the ignore list if you see them. TShock 6 and vanilla servers should use the built-in Terraria preset.
author: PteroRelay contributors
